lineage: L6 contact benchmark. Penalty-based sliding contact between elastic body and rigid surface.

governance_compliance.article_XXIV: Contact formula from FEBio source (FESlidingInterface.cpp, FEContactInterface.h)

febio_contact_from_source.key_formula: Ln = MBRACKET(Lm + eps * gap) = max(Lm + eps*gap, 0)
febio_contact_from_source.gap: distance from primary node to secondary surface (negative = penetration)
febio_contact_from_source.update: Augmented Lagrangian: solve displacement with penalty, then Lm += eps*gap if gap<0

field_5_observable: Contact pressure at interface + primary block stress
field_6_analytical: For uniform indentation against rigid: contact_pressure = elastic_stress_at_compressed_strain. With augmented Lagrangian, converges to true pressure independent of penalty.
field_9_state_vars: gap, Lm, Ln tracked with MBRACKET(Lm+eps*gap) update
key_challenge: SfePy does not natively support contact. Custom term needed: detect penetration, apply penalty force, track Lagrange multipliers. Hardest implementation so far.
